Lash Products Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Welcome to the Lash Products Affiliate Program. By signing up for our affiliate program, you agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions.

 1. Acceptance of Terms

By participating in the Lash Products Affiliate Program ("Program"), you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions ("Terms"). Lash Products reserves the right to update and modify these Terms at any time without prior notice. Continued use of the Program after any such changes shall constitute your consent to such changes.

2. Enrollment

To enroll in the Program, you must complete and submit the online application form. We reserve the right to accept or reject any application at our sole discretion.

 3. Affiliate Responsibilities

As an affiliate, you agree to:

- Promote Lash Products in a positive and ethical manner.
- Use only approved marketing materials provided by Lash Products.
- Not engage in any fraudulent, deceptive, or illegal activities.
- Ensure that your website and marketing channels comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

4. Commissions

Affiliates will earn a commission based on the sales generated through their unique affiliate links. The current commission rate is 12% of the net sales amount.


-Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid on a monthly basis, provided that the affiliate has earned a minimum commission of $25 USD. If the minimum threshold is not met, earnings will roll over to the next payment period.


- Payment Method: Payments will be made via [PayPal/Bank Transfer/Other]. Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment details.

5. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must not:

- Use their affiliate links for personal purchases.
- Engage in pay-per-click (PPC) bidding on branded keywords.
- Use misleading or false advertising.
- Spam any potential customers or use unsolicited commercial emails (UCE).

 6. Intellectual Property

Lash Products grants affiliates a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use Lash Products' trademarks, logos, and marketing materials solely for the purpose of promoting Lash Products. This license will terminate upon termination of the affiliate relationship.

7. Termination

Either party may terminate the affiliate relationship at any time, with or without cause. Upon termination, the affiliate must cease all promotion of Lash Products and remove all affiliate links and marketing materials from their website and marketing channels.

8. Limitation of Liability

Lash Products will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising in connection with the Program. Our total liability arising with respect to this Agreement will not exceed the total commission fees paid or payable to you under this Agreement.

 9. Indemnification

You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Lash Products and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, and agents from any and all claims, liabilities, damages, and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising out of or related to your participation in the Program, your use of the affiliate links, and your breach of these Terms.

By signing up for the Lash Products Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.
